arxiv-2111-07452.title: Graph theory-based structural analysis on density anomaly of silica glass
arxiv-2111-07452.creator: Aik Rui Tan, Shingo Urata*, Masatsugu Yamada, Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli*
arxiv-2111-07452.description: Abstract Analyzing the atomic structure of glassy materials is a tremendous challenge both experimentally and computationally, and the lack of direct, detailed insights into glass structure hinders our ability to navigate structure-property relationships. For instance, the structural origin of the density anomaly in silica glasses - the negative thermal expansion coefficient - is still poorly understood.

arxiv-2311-02501.title: Single-electron qubits based on quantum ring states on solid neon surface
arxiv-2311-02501.creator: Toshiaki Kanai, Dafei Jin, Wei Guo
arxiv-2311-02501.description: Abstract Single electrons trapped on solid neon surfaces (eNe) have recently emerged as a promising platform for charge qubits. Experimental results have revealed their exceptionally long coherence times, yet the actual quantum states of these trapped electrons, presumably on imperfectly flat neon surfaces, remain elusive.

arxiv-2408-09541.title: Nodal higher-order topological superconductivity from C 6 C_{6} -symmetric Dirac semimetals
arxiv-2408-09541.creator: Guan-Hao Feng
arxiv-2408-09541.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Guan-Hao Feng. Three-dimensional Dirac semimetals (DSMs) have been shown to exhibit one-dimensional hinge modes which are termed the higher-order hinge Fermi-arc (HOFA) states. They are the topological consequences of Dirac points. Superconducting states from Dirac semimetals can inherit the Dirac points to form nodal Dirac superconducting states, raising a question of whether there exists a topological superconducting bulk-hinge correspondence similar to DSMs.

arxiv-2506-08945.creator: Simone Daniotti, Johannes Wachs, Xiangnan Feng, Frank Neffke
arxiv-2506-08945.description: Abstract Generative coding tools promise big productivity gains, but uneven uptake could widen skill and income gaps. We train a neural classifier to spot AI-generated Python functions in 80 million GitHub commits (2018–2024) by 200,000 developers and track how fast—and where—these tools take hold. pmc-13209197.description: Hepatitis E is a liver inflammation caused by the hepatitis E virus (HEV). According to the World Health Organization, infection by HEV during the third trimester of pregnancy may increase the risk of maternal mortality in 20–25% of cases.

pmc-13434700.title: Seepage analysis of tunnel lining under the synergistic effect of cave-fracture networks in water-rich karst formations
pmc-13434700.creator: Guiping Li, Jian Tao, Zhiyong Shen, Jun Wang, Wei Dai, Yantao Zheng
pmc-13434700.description: Interconnected cave–fracture networks are widely developed in karst regions. The complex geometric characteristics and strong heterogeneity of these formations not only disturb groundwater flow fields but also alter the in-situ stress state of the surrounding rock, leading to the formation of irregular preferential seepage pathways. These factors pose significant challenges to the long-term stability and construction safety of underground tunnels.
